name: Why shouldn't I clean up sewage myself?

mainEntity.name: Why shouldn't I clean up sewage myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cleaning up sewage yourself is highly discouraged due to the severe health risks involved. Without proper personal protective equipment (PPE), specialized cleaning agents, and professional techniques, you risk exposure to dangerous pathogens that can cause serious illness. Additionally, improper cleanup can lead to incomplete disinfection, leaving behind harmful bacteria, mold growth, and lingering odors. Professionals have the training and equipment to ensure a safe and thorough remediation.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY sewage cleanup is dangerous due to health risks from pathogens and the difficulty of proper disinfection without professional equipment and training.
